keys.home.feature.bgRemove.desc: Remove image backgrounds automatically with AI.
keys.home.feature.convertImage.desc: Convert images to PNG, JPG, WebP, HEIF and more.
keys.home.feature.fontDownload.desc: Browse and download Google Fonts directly to your Mac.
keys.home.feature.ocr.desc: Extract text from images using optical recognition.
keys.home.feature.pdfEdit.desc: Edit, reorder, compress and manage your PDF files.
keys.home.feature.qrCode.desc: Generate and customize QR codes instantly.
keys.home.feature.stockImage.desc: Browse and download free high-quality stock photos.
keys.home.feature.videoConvert.desc: Convert and compress your videos with ease.
keys.home.guide.bgRemove.desc: Remove image backgrounds automatically using Apple's Neural Engine.
keys.home.guide.bgRemove.step2: The background is removed instantly using on-device AI.
keys.home.guide.bgRemove.step3: Choose PNG or WebP output format and save.
keys.home.guide.bgRemove.tip: Works best on photos with a clear subject. Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later.
keys.home.guide.convertImage.desc: Convert images between 15+ formats with quality and resize options.
keys.home.guide.convertImage.step2: Choose the output format (PNG, JPG, WebP, HEIC, etc.) from the right panel.
keys.home.guide.convertImage.step3: Adjust quality, scale, or dimensions — then convert.
keys.home.guide.convertImage.tip: You can add multiple images at once. Each file is converted independently with the same settings.
keys.home.guide.font.desc: Browse and install Google Fonts directly to your Mac.
keys.home.guide.font.step1: Search for a font by name or browse the catalog.
keys.home.guide.font.step2: Preview the font and select the styles you want.
keys.home.guide.font.step3: Click Download to install the font on your Mac.
keys.home.guide.font.tip: Downloaded fonts are installed system-wide and available in all apps immediately.
keys.home.guide.ocr.desc: Extract and copy text from any image using optical character recognition.
keys.home.guide.ocr.step2: The tool automatically detects and extracts all text.
keys.home.guide.ocr.step3: Copy the recognized text or save it as a file.
keys.home.guide.ocr.tip: Works with printed text, screenshots, and scanned documents.
keys.home.guide.pdf.desc: Edit, reorder, compress and manage your PDF files.
keys.home.guide.pdf.step1: Drag & drop a PDF file onto the editor.
keys.home.guide.pdf.step2: Switch to Reorder mode to drag pages into a new order, or delete pages.
keys.home.guide.pdf.step3: Use Optimize PDF to compress the file — choose a quality level.
keys.home.guide.pdf.step4: Click Save PDF to export your changes.
keys.home.guide.pdf.tip: Use Ctrl+Z to undo any page deletion or reorder operation.
keys.home.guide.qr.desc: Generate custom QR codes for URLs, text, or any data.
keys.home.guide.qr.step1: Type or paste a URL or any text into the input field.
keys.home.guide.qr.step2: Customize the foreground/background colors and corner radius.
keys.home.guide.qr.step3: Download the QR code as PNG or SVG in your chosen resolution.
keys.home.guide.qr.tip: Higher resolution exports look better when printed on physical materials.
keys.home.guide.step.convert: Click the Convert button and wait for the result.
keys.home.guide.step.drop: Drag & drop your files onto the tool, or click to browse.
keys.home.guide.stock.desc: Search and download free high-quality stock photos from Pexels.
keys.home.guide.stock.step1: Type a keyword (e.g. 'mountain', 'office') into the search bar.
keys.home.guide.stock.step2: Browse the results and select the photos you want.
keys.home.guide.stock.step3: Click Download to save the selected photos in original or low quality.
keys.home.guide.stock.tip: All photos are free to use under the Pexels license.
keys.home.guide.subtitle: Tap any feature below to see step-by-step instructions and load ready-made presets.
keys.home.guide.title: How does each tool work?
keys.home.guide.upscale.desc: Sharpen and enlarge photos with the on-device AI upscaler (2×–16×).
keys.home.guide.upscale.step2: Choose scale and output format (PNG, JPEG, WebP…) in the right panel.
keys.home.guide.upscale.step3: Optionally tap Preview to compare before and after with the slider.
keys.home.guide.upscale.step4: Pick a target folder, then tap Upscale to save all processed images.
keys.home.guide.upscale.tip: 8× and 16× run multiple AI passes and take longer. Supported raster formats only.
keys.home.guide.video.desc: Convert and compress videos to MP4, MOV, AVI and more.
keys.home.guide.video.step2: Select the output format (MP4, MOV…) and adjust FPS or resolution.
keys.home.guide.video.step3: Enable or disable audio, then click Convert.
keys.home.guide.video.tip: For the smallest file size, choose 50% resolution and 30 FPS for social media sharing.
keys.home.guide.videoedit.desc: Trim clips, remove unwanted parts, and merge multiple videos into one.
keys.home.guide.videoedit.step1: Add one or more video files using the + button or drag & drop.
keys.home.guide.videoedit.step2: Select a clip, then drag the trim handles on the timeline to set start and end points.
keys.home.guide.videoedit.step3: Reorder clips in the list by dragging them to set the final sequence.
keys.home.guide.videoedit.step4: Choose an output format and folder, then click Export.
keys.home.guide.videoedit.tip: Trim handles snap to the millisecond — use the playback bar to preview the exact cut.
